title: Editorial
note: Instrument Serif italic + Inter Tight. Echoes the website hero type; premium, human.

title: Observatory
note: Wide-tracked caps under a centred symbol. Calm, architectural, enterprise.

title: Domain
note: JetBrains Mono, the name as an address: destiny.cloud. Speaks to engineers.

title: Soft lowercase
note: Sora, all lowercase, "cloud" in Ember. Friendly, modern SaaS.

title: Two-line stack
note: Space Grotesk on two lines beside a hairline rule. Compact, technical, great for headers.

title: Dawn
note: The name sits under the arc, on the horizon line: the sun rises over the brand. An emblem.

title: Heritage
note: Fraunces serif, centred under the symbol. Established, trustworthy, a firm not a startup.

title: Industrial
note: Oswald condensed caps, heavy DESTINY + light CLOUD. Infrastructure, strength, data centres.

title: Tittle
note: Manrope ExtraBold lowercase; the dot of the i is the arc. The mark lives inside the name.

title: Badge
note: Symbol in a soft tile + Plus Jakarta Sans. App-ready lockup; the tile doubles as the favicon.
